logic.par.text:
to artifact_priority_score with stable_units as number, fragile_units as number, packing_stations as number, expedited as yesno giving number:
    let artifact_total be stable_units plus fragile_units
    let packing_units be stable_units times 6 plus fragile_units times 11
    if expedited:
        set packing_units to packing_units plus packing_stations times 4
    let capacity_units be packing_stations times 40
    let overflow_units be packing_units minus capacity_units
    if overflow_units is not at least 0:
        set overflow_units to 0
    let inspection_rounds be number from (artifact_total divided by 5)
    give back packing_units plus overflow_units times 5 plus inspection_rounds times 7
